proposed.explanation: While patterns are textural, texture is about material surface quality. Texture varies from smooth to rough. Texture is about surface property, not structural weight. Texture is surface quality—rough, fine, smooth, coarse. It expresses material properties (rough stone feels permanent; smooth glass feels dematerialized), affects tactile perception, and operates at multiple scales visually and tactilely.
